notes.title: Bug Fixes Update
notes.content:
Hello, friends! We are happy to say that we have fixed the following issues occuring in the game:

-Game crashing at Nukeart's logo.
-First time playing came with game mostly complete.
-Bonus rooms appeared being locked but marked as complete.

You may now enjoy the game's proper experience, let us know if everything works on your end!

notes.title: Recent Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620022/d4f2aff316fceb148e9ebf8c2409730343966c3c.jpg[/img]

Hello friends, we have been working on all games from Hidden Cats Series to fix reported issues.
Here are the last updates for Spooky Town.


[list]
[*] FIXED - Meow SFX options not working properly;
[*] FIXED - No cats in Normal mode bug;
[*] Enhancements to avoid game break.
[/list]


NOTE:
Due to the technical nature of the game, sometimes updates can be quite big compared to the game size already installed, even when the update itself is a small thing. But, make note that this won't increase too much of your install files as it is already.
